competences.description: Attacks the enemy with a strong mental force and removes a beneficial effect. Increases the provoke duration by 1 turn if the Boss attacks a provoked enemy.
Manifests a horrible delusion and attacks all enemies, decreases the Defense for 3 turns and provokes them for 2 turns. Damage increases according to the number of merges.
Summons 2 of the 3 incarnations within and removes all harmful effects. Each incarnation will have its own skill and characteristics, and will merge with Lyrith after 5 turns.
